Klefki

Steel Fairy

Kalos · Generation 6

Klefki is a Steel/Fairy-type Key Ring Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.2 m tall and weighs 3 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Defense (91), with a base stat total of 470.
